name: Monteverde
tagline: Cloud forest of hanging bridges and quetzals
summary: Monteverde is a misty mountain region of cloud forest reserves founded by Quaker settlers. Walk the reserves looking for the resplendent quetzal, cross hanging bridges at canopy height, fly on some of the world's longest ziplines, join a night walk for tarantulas and sloths, and tour coffee and chocolate farms.
seasonNote: Dry season December to April; quetzals easiest to see March to June.
arrival: About 3.5 hours by road from San José or La Fortuna (jeep-boat-jeep from Arenal).
gettingAround: Buses and taxis; tours include pickups.
cashTip: Cards and US dollars widely accepted; colones for small places. Restaurants add 10 percent service.
foodTip: Casado, gallo pinto, and Monteverde cheese.
